briefdescription.para: Size of the array that receives a fragment of the totals.

detaileddescription.para: Large enough for ", N test cases failed", the longest fragment (20 characters and the count), and the terminator, with the count of the largest size_t value (10 digits on 32-bit targets, 20 on 64-bit ones, as in ", 18446744073709551615 test cases failed").

briefdescription.para: Output stream manipulator for ending a line in test reports.

detaileddescription.para: Calls reporter::end_line(), which appends a line ending to the internal buffer. Unlike std::endl, it does not flush; the buffer is written later, by the concrete reporters.

stream
Reference to the reporter instance.
Reference to the same reporter instance, enabling chaining of output operations.
The endl function calls reporter::end_line(), which appends a newline character to the buffer of the specified reporter.

briefdescription.para: Formats the number of items skipped by the filter.

detaileddescription.para: The text is ", <count> skipped", appended to the count of the items, or empty when no item was skipped, so that the totals lines of the runs without a filter are not longer.

parameterdescription.para: The character array that receives the null-terminated text.

briefdescription.para: Returns the plural suffix for a count.

detaileddescription.para: The totals lines are in English, where only the count 1 takes the singular form.

parameterdescription.para: The count that precedes the noun.

briefdescription.para: Writes a text to a file, without the ANSI colour sequences.

detaileddescription.para: The text may contain ANSI colour sequences, added when the console is a terminal, which must not reach the file. They are removed while writing: each ESC [, followed by any digits and semicolons, and terminated by m, is skipped, and the text between the sequences is written unchanged. Any other use of ESC is written as is. No line ending is appended.

parameterdescription.para: The file to write to; must not be null.

briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ test reporter member functions.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the core implementations for the test reporting facilities of the µTest++ framework. It provides lifecycle and utility behaviour for reporters, including output-file handling, informational banner emission, buffering helpers, stream operators, the formatting of the totals and of the elapsed times, and pass/fail dispatch to reporter-specific prefix/suffix hooks. The command-line options are parsed by the runner.
Concrete formatting behaviour is implemented by derived reporters (reporter_human and reporter_tap).
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
